AC-AMENDMENT (gap-analysis):
1. Off-by-one: 'cursor at commit-1 SHA' means checkpoint records the SHA of commit 1. On next run, we process commit-1..HEAD = commits 2, 3, 4 (3 events). To observe all 4 events, checkpoint must be at the empty-tree / initial commit (before any event commits). Use cursor=None (cold-start path) OR set cursor to the SHA of a 'setup' commit that precedes the 4 event commits.
2. Entry-point invocation: import bridge_outbound via importlib.util (matching existing test patterns for bridge scripts), then call process_events() directly. The test exercises the git subprocess call internally — this catches shell-level diff-window regressions even in pytest.
